notablePrerequisites: Case of the Pilfered Proof has been solved.
description:
Cause a noncreature Clue to enter the battlefield under your control, which will be an Equipment due to Armed with Proof if it isn't an Equipment already, causing Barret to trigger.
Resolve Barret's first ability, creating a 2/2 red Rebel creature token plus creating an additional Clue token through Case of the Pilfered Proof (which will be an Equipment due to Armed with Proof), causing Barret to trigger.
Repeat from step 2.
